entities.name: Query CTP synthase
observations: 543-aa protein; sequence-derived mass 60.5 kDa, pI 5.88, instability index 30.7, and GRAVY −0.256.
Strong homology supports CTP synthase: 70.7% identity and 98.3% query coverage to reviewed Rhodopirellula baltica UniProt Q7UJ86.
Homolog annotation: ATP-dependent amination of UTP to CTP using glutamine or ammonia; EC 6.3.4.2; pyrimidine de novo biosynthesis.
Homologs are annotated as homotetramers; localization annotations include cytosol, but these are reference annotations rather than direct predictions for the query.

entities.name: CTP synthase Q7UJ86
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference CTP synthase from Rhodopirellula baltica; query alignment identity 70.7%, query coverage 98.3%, E-value 2.46e-280.
Annotated EC 6.3.4.2; catalyzes ATP-dependent conversion of UTP to CTP, with glutamine or ammonia as nitrogen source; annotated homotetramer.
